obligations.source_text: A back/limited rear three-quarter full-body view must keep both shoulders, straps, upper spine, lower band, and the full outfit inspectable.

bindings.two_separate_shoulder_straps_phrase: two separate shoulder straps leave the left and right shoulders and remain independently traceable before convergence
bindings.central_scapular_convergence_phrase: both straps visibly converge between the shoulder blades at the central upper back
bindings.single_y_or_narrow_back_yoke_phrase: one narrow Y-shaped racerback yoke continues below the convergence along the upper spine
bindings.strap_to_lower_band_continuity_phrase: the central yoke remains visibly attached to the lower bra band in one continuous garment structure
bindings.parallel_crossback_halter_confound_contr: parallel straps, an X crossing, and a halter neck remain visibly excluded by the topology
